reviewMode.title: How do you want to learn?
reviewMode.subtitle: Pick a mode for your first lesson — you can switch anytime while learning.

audio.title: Shadowing
audio.description: Listen to a sentence, translate it in your head, then say it aloud to practice your pronunciation. Speak from day one — hands-free anywhere.

translate.title: Translate
translate.description: Hear your language, type the translation — with instant, character-level spelling feedback.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.description: Hear only the target language, type what you hear — with instant, character-level spelling feedback.

difficulty.title: How much do you already know?

elementary.title: Basic
elementary.description: I know the most common words

learnNew.title: Learn New
learnNew.description: Picks fresh sentences you haven't seen yet — perfect when you want to grow your vocabulary.

learnAndReview.title: Learn + Review
learnAndReview.description: Mixes new sentences with cards due for spaced repetition, so you keep what you've learned while picking up more.

radioMode.title: Radio
radioMode.description: Audio-only background playback — your cards loop hands-free without affecting their spaced-repetition schedule.

freeStudyMode.title: Free Study
freeStudyMode.description: Browse your sentences freely in Writing mode — no scheduling, no ratings. Only available in Writing.

reviewModeToggle.title: Shadowing vs Writing
reviewModeToggle.description: Switch between Shadowing (hear the sentence and say it aloud) and Writing (type the translation and get instant feedback).

contentSource.title: Pick your source
contentSource.description: Choose whether to study only premade sentences, only your own custom cards, or both at once.

dueCounts.title: What’s waiting for you
dueCounts.description: These pills show how many sentences are new and how many are due for review with your current content selection.

workload.title: Your week ahead
workload.description: This card sums up how much review time each of the next seven days will bring — tap it to open the full chart and preview what adding more sentences would do.

projections.title: Your forecast
projections.description: This rotating forecast projects your progress — like how many words you’ll know by the end of the year at your current pace. Tap it to see the next fact.

difficultySelection.title: Difficulty Selection
difficultySelection.description: Here you can select your difficulty. Each difficulty is a collection of sentences for you to learn. They have been chosen based on word frequency such that you learn the most common words first. You can click on a collection to preview the upcoming sentences. Once you are ready, start with one of the learning modes.

readyToLearn.title: Are you ready to continue learning?

chat.title: Chat Assistant
chat.description: Use the chat to ask about grammar, get explanations, or create new sentences. The AI assistant is here to help you learn!

audio.title: Welcome to Shadowing
audio.description: In this mode you can review sentences hands-off. The texts are read aloud automatically. Let's walk through how it works.

full.title: Welcome to Writing
full.description: In this mode you actively practise writing and get instant feedback. Let's walk through how it works.

switchedAudio.title: Switched to Shadowing
switchedAudio.description: You'll listen first and reveal the translation after. Here's what changes.

switchedFull.title: Switched to Writing
switchedFull.description: You'll type the translation yourself and get instant feedback. Here's what changes.

card.title: The card
card.descriptionAudio: Each card shows a sentence in the languages you're learning. The target language is hidden until you reveal it.
card.descriptionFull: Each card shows a sentence in the languages you're learning. You'll type the translation and check yourself.
card.descriptionFullTranscribe: Each card plays a sentence in your target language. You'll type what you hear and check yourself.

shownTranslation.title: Shown the first time
shownTranslation.description: On a brand-new sentence the translation is shown here so you can learn it by typing it out. On later reviews it stays hidden — you'll translate from memory.

reveal.title: Reveal the translation
reveal.description: The target translation is hidden by default. Tap it to reveal, or just listen — it reveals automatically once the target plays after the base. New cards play the target once at the start; when it's your turn to answer, try to recall it from memory.

input.title: Type your translation
input.description: Type the target-language translation here and hit submit. New sentences show the translation the first time — just type it out to learn it; later reviews test you without it. You’ll get instant feedback on each word.

inputTranscribe.title: Type what you hear
inputTranscribe.description: Type exactly what you hear in the target language and hit submit. New sentences show the text the first time — just type it out to learn it; later reviews test you without it. You’ll get instant feedback on each word.

audioControls.title: Audio plays automatically
audioControls.description: When a card is new, the target language plays once at the beginning so you hear what you're aiming for. Then the base language plays, pauses for you to think, and the target follows. Restart, play / pause, or skip to the next card here. The undo button on the far left takes back your last rating and brings the previous card back.

ratingAudio.title: Rate how well you knew it
ratingAudio.description: Each card is repeated a few times before it enters spaced repetition. Still learning keeps it in the warm-up rotation. Understood means you know it — skip the warm-up and start spaced repetition right away. After a few reviews you'll see Again / Hard / Good / Easy.

ratingFull.title: Rate how well you knew it
ratingFull.description: After every answer, rate how well you knew it. Again means you didn't know it — the card comes back quickly. Hard, Good, and Easy push the next review further out. Be honest — over-rating a card you didn't really know will haunt you later.

autoAdd.title: Adding cards
autoAdd.description: By default new cards are added automatically as the ones you have run out — everything is optimised for you using spaced repetition. This avoids cramming and takes care of pacing for you. You do not need to worry about when to add new cards.

cardActions.title: Card options
cardActions.description: Star a card to favourite it, mark it as mastered (it stops appearing in review), hide it from your deck, or edit/delete it. Use these whenever a card is too easy, too hard, or just wrong for you. You can also flag a wrong translation, or regenerate the audio.

wordTap.title: Tap any word
wordTap.description: Tap a word in the target sentence to ask the chat what it means. The chat can also create a new flashcard for it on the spot.

chat.title: Your AI language tutor
chat.description: The chat is a tutor that knows the language you're learning. Ask why a sentence is phrased a certain way, get grammar explained at your level, request examples, or have the chat turn an idea into a new flashcard — translation and audio are generated automatically so the card is ready to study.

modeSwitch.title: Try the other mode
modeSwitch.descriptionAudio: You've been learning in Shadowing mode. There's also Writing, where you type the translation and get instant word-by-word feedback. You can switch between the two anytime in the settings up here. You can also customize almost everything here. And this will be the last information.
modeSwitch.descriptionFull: You've been learning in Writing mode. There's also Shadowing, where sentences are read aloud and you review hands-free. You can switch between the two anytime in the settings up here. You can also customize almost everything here. And this will be the last information.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.description: There's a lot you can customize in the settings — playback speed, language order, auto-advance, how many new cards are added, and more. Take a look when you're curious.

DifficultyCheck.title: Does the difficulty feel right?
DifficultyCheck.subtitle: Before we add new sentences, check the level. Step left for easier, right for harder — you can change this anytime from the home screen.
DifficultyCheck.switchFailed: Could not switch the level. Please try again.

banner.title: Cookies and analytics
banner.description: May we use analytics cookies and session recordings to improve the app? Details:

settings.title: Cookie settings
settings.description: Choose what we may measure. Your choice applies to this browser and can be changed whenever you like.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Keeps you signed in and remembers your language and layout. The app cannot work without these, so they cannot be switched off.

analytics.title: Product analytics and session replay
analytics.description: Helps us see which features are used, where onboarding breaks, and what errors people hit. Includes recordings of your screen in which everything you type into form fields is hidden before it leaves your browser. If you decline, we still measure usage without cookies and without recordings.
